found.quote: Plagiarism is presenting someone else’s work or ideas as your own. This includes self- plagiarism which involves submitting the same work that you have previously submitted for another assessment where this is not allowed. This may also include the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools beyond what is permitted in the assessment instructions.
Penalties usually increase with each upheld case. This means that we will consider prior warnings and upheld academic misconduct outcomes against you when deciding the penalty in a current case.
If you do not attend either opportunity, the matter will be referred for investigation.
found.anchor: Where a viva voce is required
